policy_metadata.insurer_name: Star Health & Allied Insurance Co. Ltd.

source.text: Section 1.1 — Basic Sum Insured: The maximum aggregate liability of the Company for all claims arising during the Policy Period shall be INR 5,00,000 (Five Lakhs Only) as specified in the Policy Schedule.

Section 3.2 — Room, Boarding and Nursing Expenses: Daily room rent, boarding and nursing expenses incurred during hospitalization are capped up to 1% of the Sum Insured per day. If the Insured Person occupies a room with rent higher than the limit stated herein, the Insured shall bear a proportionate share of all associated medical and surgical expenses.

room_rent_rule.description: Room rent restricted to 1% of Sum Insured (₹5,000/day). Proportionate deduction applies to associate medical charges if room rent exceeds ₹5,000/day.

copay.conditions: Applicable on each and every admissible inpatient claim.

source.text: Section 4.7 — Co-payment Clause: A compulsory co-payment of 10% (ten percent) shall apply on every admissible claim amount settled under this policy. The Company's liability shall be restricted to the balance 90% of the admissible claim amount.

sub_limits.description: Maximum claim liability for Laparoscopic Appendectomy is capped at ₹40,000 per hospitalization.

source.text: Section 6.1 — Specified Procedure Sub-limits: The Company's maximum liability for Appendectomy (including Laparoscopic and Open techniques) shall not exceed INR 40,000 per hospitalization, irrespective of the Sum Insured chosen.

sub_limits.description: Cataract surgery limited to ₹35,000 per eye.

source.text: Section 6.2 — Cataract Sub-limit: Liability for Cataract treatment is limited to INR 35,000 per eye per policy year.
Section 6.3 — Hernia Treatment: Coverage for Inguinal or Ventral Hernia is limited to INR 50,000 per claim.
Section 2.3 — Voluntary Deductible: No voluntary deductible has been opted under this policy schedule.

exclusions.name: Cosmetic and Aesthetic Surgery
exclusions.description: Surgeries performed purely for aesthetic or beautification purposes.

source.text: Section 7.1 — Permanent Exclusions: Expenses incurred on cosmetic or aesthetic treatments, plastic surgery unless reconstructive following an accident, are excluded.

exclusions.name: Unproven or Experimental Treatments
exclusions.description: Treatments and drugs lacking established clinical trials.

source.text: Section 7.4 — Unproven Treatments: Any medical procedure or drug therapy not recognized by the Indian Medical Council is excluded.
Section 4.1 — Pre-Existing Disease Waiting Period: A waiting period of 24 consecutive months of continuous coverage shall apply to all pre-existing medical conditions disclosed at inception.
Section 4.2 — Specific Illness Waiting Period: A 24-month waiting period applies for benign prostatic hypertrophy, hernia, hydrocele, knee and hip joint replacements.
